text_block_list.text:
While enjoying some leisure time with Buena Vista,
she led me on a visit to a town a little further out.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I've been wanting to visit this restaurant nearby for so long.
I hope you like it too.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Well then, shall we head out?
First, we go straight down the main street, right?

I couldn't help but feel a little worried. Ever since
she was little, she was the type of horse girl who easily lost her way.
choice_data_list: Want me to look at the map with you?
Shall I look at the map with you, too?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, don't worry.
I'm not a little kid anymore, you know?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: I've checked the route to the restaurant tons of times! I'll show you just how much I've grown!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I wonder what kind of food would be good.
Maybe a salad bowl for two would be nice♪

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Um, next we turn right
and then go straight for a while, right?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Turn right here... right...?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Um, the GPS margin of error is pretty big...
I think we're heading in the right direction, though.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Um, looks like it's not this way...!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
For now, let's backtrack!
If we get back to where we started, we should be fine!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
S-Sorry! Looks like I got lost.
Ugh, how pathetic of me...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Still, I think once the GPS signal improves,
I'll be able to navigate properly.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
So, why don't we take a short break?
I'm sure we can reach our goal together!

However, guiding someone around an unfamiliar town
must be exhausting.
...Is there anything I can do to help?
choice_data_list: Hang on, I'll go find something we can use as a landmark!
One sec, I'll go find something we can use as a landmark, okay?

text_block_list.text: I turn my back to her. If I recall correctly, there should be a scenic viewpoint just ahead.

—At that moment,
someone tightly grabbed the hem of my clothes.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
S-Sorry! It's nothing.
Um... don't worry about it.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: I'll... wait here, okay?

text_block_list.name: Young Buena
text_block_list.text:
"Huh...? W-Wait!
I want to go with you, Big Brother...!"

text_block_list.name: Young Buena
text_block_list.text:
"Huh...? W-Wait!
I want to go with you, Big Sister...!"

text_block_list.name: Young Buena
text_block_list.text: Buu-chan was scared... that she might be alone forever...!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer?
choice_data_list: Maybe I should take a little break too!
Maybe I should take a little break too!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?
choice_data_list: After that, let's go look for the landmark together.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ! U-Um... I see.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: “You're right. Searching together would definitely be more reliable. Well then... shall we take it easy for a bit?”

...After taking a break, we leave the shrine behind.
Aiming for the restaurant, the two of us walk—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Um, if I remember correctly, we cross this bridge and... ah—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Found it. That's the one, Trainer!
...Thank goodness...!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, delicious...
It's like it's soaking into my body.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry. Making you walk so far
just because I got lost...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Fufu... You really are so kind, my dear childhood friend.

Yes, precisely because they are childhood friends,
she knows that when she was little,
she was a lonely, clingy child.

I thought she had grown into a fine young woman.
...And yet...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...?
Trainer?
choice_data_list: If you ever need help, just let me know anytime.
If you ever need help, just let me know anytime, okay?
I was just thinking that there are still things you struggle with.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...?
Trainer?
choice_data_list: If you ever need help, just let me know anytime.
If you ever need help, just let me know anytime, okay?
I was just thinking that there are still things you struggle with.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, thank you.
...But I'm not a kid anymore.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I can't just keep relying on others,
I need to pull myself together too. First of all—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I really need to do something about getting lost so easily.
...Ahaha.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... How embarrassing.
I really wanted to show you around properly.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I know!
Let me make it up to you next time by showing you the way again.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Because I want you to see
how much I've grown, Trainer!
